title: Boli ye zainab dukhya tera chehlum karne
body:
Boli ye zainab dukhya tera chehlum karne
bhai mai aai hu karbobala chehlum karne
<<DIVIDER>>
aapki laadli ko shaam ke zindaa'n me aqi
chord kar aayi hu mai aapka chehlum karne
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khule koofe ke aur shaam ke bazaro se
phir ke aayi hai behen bhai ka chehlum karne
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho uth ke to zara bhai ye ujda kunba
lut ke aaya hai mera qafela chehlum karne
<<DIVIDER>>
boli laila mere atthara baras ke paale
haaye mai reh gayi beta tera chehlum karne
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn karke shahe mazloom ko abid ne kaha
haaye qismat meri mai reh gaya chehlum karne
